title: 第9章 踏入超凡第一步第10章 纽约地铁神人多
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
麦迪逊大道的公交站牌和国内的公交站牌比起来并无太大区别，但是比起布鲁克林第8大道的公交站牌看上去要干净至少一万倍还不止。
没有各个帮派占据的涂鸦、没有公交站内的流浪汉和站牌下的尿渍，李维很快就找到了自己要乘坐的线路：首先是从麦迪逊大道往南坐，不管是M1到M4任何一条线路都可以，随后在42-59街区之间下车，紧接着乘坐横向公交M34坐到第8大道附近。
只不过——
“平均20分钟一班公交车？”李维有些吃惊地看着上面的时刻表，“不过看在一趟公交车只要3美金的份上，20分钟一班的公交车似乎也不是不能接受。”
有了120美金的打车费在前，李维已经开始觉得3美金坐一次公交车并不算什么奢侈的行为了。
但是实际上公交站牌上的时刻表就像女人的嘴一样没一句实话。
李维足足在站台里等了接近半个小时才等来了一辆有气无力的黄色公交车。
也得亏他在富人云集的麦迪逊大道，如果是在第8大街他肯定是不会在一个公开场合停留这么久的。
登上公交车，使用手机刷了2.9美金之后，李维提着包环顾四周，坐在了最后一排的角落位置。
车上只有几个跟他年纪差不多大的黑人或者白人，看样子也是在附近打工的。
从地图的显示来看，这一趟公交车的旅程需要耗费他接近一个半小时的时间，他正好用来先预习一下高中的课程。
就在他坐下来的那一瞬间，屁股刚刚挨到座椅，脑海中就跳出了一个声音：
【任务：第一次阅读古代石碑完成】
【你成功的阅读了晦涩的古代石碑，破解了其中的奥秘。魔法议会应该把你的功绩刻入到岁月史书中。】
【获得奖励：自由属性点+0.1】
其实倒也没有这么大的功绩了，李维摸了摸鼻子，暗自想道。
他拿出了之前在学校的地下室领到的一本AP宏观经济学，从头翻了起来。
“哦......房地产交易委员会？”
看了一会儿，李维把视线投向窗外。
他现在才知道为什么纽约的街道都是第xx大道、多少街区这样。因为在1811年的委员会计划当中，资本为了更方便地、以标准化的单位出售土地，把曼哈切成了一块块标准的矩形。并且为了效率，纽约也直接用数字编号进行编写，易于管理和扩建。

缓缓地跟着黄色的公交车一路从第5大道摇晃到了第8大道，一个小时之后李维合上书之后再次回想：
“等等，”他自言自语道，“委员会计划是什么时候发布的来着？”
【精神1.0】——【精神1.1】
【检测到精神升级】——【拙劣口才技能发生变化】
【效果：你有50%的概率说服意志力薄弱的贪婪之人。】——【效果：你有60%的概率说服意志力薄弱的贪婪之人。】
当第一次李维有一项属性突破了普通人的极限的时候，整个世界和记忆在他的眼中发生了不可思议的变化。
这种感觉很难用语言去精准地形容，如果非要打一个比方，那就像是一台原本运行卡顿、后台挂满进程的老旧电脑，突然被清理了内存，并且换上了一块儿崭新的固态硬盘。
以前李维看书的时候，文字进入眼睛，需要在大脑里面先“转”一圈，费力地咀嚼、理解，然后才能变成短时的记忆。
但是当他的【精神】属性从1.0跳到1.1的时候，世界仿佛有那么一瞬间，从磨砂玻璃变成了透光度良好的玻璃。
那一页关于1811年委员会计划的文字重新浮现，并且深深地刻进了他的记忆当中。
甚至不仅仅是记忆力。
公交车上原本空调运作时的嗡嗡声、前面两个黑人讨论昨天晚上的BA比赛的声音、轮胎碾压过路面的触感.......这些原本混杂在一起让他感到烦躁的背景噪音，此时却在他的耳朵中变得层次分明。
他可以轻易地将注意力集中在任何一个声音上，亦可以选择将它们屏蔽，专心于手中的课本。
这就是小天才的感受吗？李维有些沉迷这种提升带来的变化。不过好景不长，过了大约半个小时，这种精神力提升带来的兴奋感和周围环境的摧残让他的专注程度有所下滑。不过尽管如此，等到李维走下公交车，回到日落公园的时候，他还是能明显地感受到自己的记忆力和专注程度猛地提高了一大截。
再次回到布鲁克林，第8大道的空气中又重新充满了熟悉的、令人安心而又嫌弃的油烟味、叶子味和海鲜的腥味。李维这次没有直接回到地下室，而是拐进了一家华人开的生鲜超市。
既然挣到了一点钱，他就不会再吃打折的面包和免费的救济粮。
他在肉类区挑挑拣拣，最后买了2大块厚切的牛后腿肉——虽然比起做牛排的肉眼和西冷来说，牛后腿的脂肪含量低、但是蛋白质高且便宜。然后又买了一大桶家庭装的脱脂牛奶和一袋儿米饭。
回到家的时候，李维推开门，一股熟悉的霉味扑面而来。
堂吉诃德今天出奇的安静。这几天他天天白天搬砖、晚上洗盘子，似乎真的是累坏了。此时他正躺在那个破床垫上，手里还捏着那本半湿不干的骑士小说，呼噜打得震天响，完全没有醒过来的迹象。
李维摇了摇头，走到角落里的简易煤气炉旁边（谢天谢地它没被水泡得不能使用），起锅烧油。

廉价的牛后腿在平底锅里面滋滋作响，美拉德反应带来的肉香很快就压过了地下室的霉味。李维只撒了一点点黑胡椒，煎到了七分熟就盛了出来。
给堂吉诃德也留了一份之后，李维狼吞虎咽地吃完了自己的那一份，感受着热量和蛋白质在胃里化开，流向四肢百骸。
也不知道是不是系统提升的缘故，他来到纽约之后比之前能吃了很多。体质的提升或许也带来了饭量的提升，他现在一顿可以吃掉整整500的牛排和其他的一些食材。
回到了自己的隔间，李维很快就让自己沉浸在了阅读当中，开始埋头苦学。
他的时间很宝贵，不仅要在2周内把数据提上来，成功转职拿到奖励搬出去，还需要通过一个月后的入学测试和橄榄球队的选拔。
content_en:
The bus stop sign on Madison Avenue is not much different from the bus stop sign in China, but it looks at least 10,000 times cleaner than the bus stop sign on 8th Avenue in Brooklyn.
There were no graffiti occupied by various gangs, no homeless people in the bus stops, and no urine stains under the stop signs. Levi quickly found the route he wanted to take: first, take the route south from Madison Avenue, whether it is M1 to M4, then get off between blocks 42-59, and then take the horizontal bus M34 to near 8th Avenue.
It’s just——
"On average, buses run every 20 minutes?" Levi looked at the timetable above with some surprise, "But since a bus only costs 3 US dollars, a bus running every 20 minutes doesn't seem unacceptable."
With the taxi fare of 120 US dollars in front of him, Levi has begun to feel that taking a bus for 3 US dollars is not a luxury.
But in fact, the timetable on the bus stop sign is as unclear as a woman's mouth.
Levi waited at the platform for nearly half an hour before a feeble yellow bus arrived.
It was also thanks to the fact that he was on Madison Avenue, where rich people gathered. If he were on 8th Street, he would definitely not stay in a public place for so long.
After boarding the bus and swiping $2.9 on his mobile phone, Levi looked around with his bag in hand and sat in the corner of the last row.
There were only a few black or white people about his age in the car, and they seemed to be working nearby.
Judging from the map display, this bus journey would take him nearly an hour and a half, which he could use to preview his high school courses.
The moment he sat down, with his butt touching the seat, a voice popped up in his mind:
[Task: First reading of ancient stone tablet completed]
[You successfully read the obscure ancient stone tablet and deciphered its secrets. The Magic Council should engrave your achievements in the history books of time. 】
[Reward: free attribute point +0.1]
In fact, it's not such a big achievement, Li Wei touched his nose and thought to himself.
He took out the AP Macroeconomics book he had received in the basement of the school and started reading it from the beginning.
“Oh…Real Estate Board?”
After watching for a while, Levi cast his gaze out the window.
Only now did he know why the streets in New York were all like XX Avenue and how many blocks there were. Because in the 1811 committee plan, capital cut Manha into standard rectangles in order to sell land more conveniently in standardized units. And for the sake of efficiency, New York is also directly numbered, making it easier to manage and expand.
Slowly following the yellow bus from 5th Avenue to 8th Avenue, Levi closed the book an hour later and thought about it again:
"Wait," he said to himself, "when was the committee plan released?"
【Spirit 1.0】——【Spirit 1.1】
[Spirit Upgrade Detected]——[Clumsy Eloquence Skills Changed]
[Effect: You have a 50% chance of convincing a greedy person with weak willpower. 】——[Effect: You have a 60% probability of convincing a greedy person with weak willpower. 】
When for the first time one of Levi's attributes exceeded the limits of ordinary people, the entire world and memory underwent incredible changes in his eyes.
It's difficult to describe this feeling accurately in words. If I had to use an analogy, it would be like an old computer that was originally running laggy and full of processes in the background. It suddenly had its memory cleared and replaced with a brand new solid-state drive.
When Li Wei was reading in the past, when words entered his eyes, they had to "turn" around in his brain first, chewing and understanding them with great effort, and thenOnly then can it become short-term memory.
But when his [Spirit] attribute jumped from 1.0 to 1.1, the world seemed to have changed from frosted glass to glass with good translucency for an instant.
The page about the 1811 Committee's plan resurfaced and was etched deeply into his memory.
Not even just memory.
The hum of the air conditioner on the bus was operating, the sound of the two black men in front discussing last night's BA game, the feel of tires grinding against the road... These background noises that were originally mixed together to make him feel irritated, now became distinct in his ears.
He could easily focus on any sound, or he could choose to block them out and focus on the textbook in his hand.
Is this how a little genius feels? Levi was a little obsessed with the changes brought about by this improvement. However, the good times did not last long. After about half an hour, the excitement brought by this increase in mental power and the devastation of the surrounding environment caused his concentration to decline. But despite this, when Levi stepped off the bus and returned to Sunset Park, he could clearly feel that his memory and concentration had greatly improved.
Back in Brooklyn, the air on 8th Avenue is once again filled with the familiar, reassuring yet disgusting smell of oil smoke, leaves and seafood. Levi did not go back to the basement directly this time, but turned into a Chinese-owned fresh food supermarket.
Now that he has earned some money, he will no longer eat discounted bread and free relief food.
He picked in the meat section and finally bought two large pieces of thick-cut beef shank. Although beef shank has lower fat content than ribeye and sirloin for steak, it is high in protein and cheap. Then I bought a large tub of family-sized skim milk and a bag of rice.
When he got home, Levi opened the door and felt a familiar musty smell.
Don Quixote was strangely quiet today. In the past few days, he moved bricks during the day and washed dishes at night. He seemed really exhausted. At this moment, he was lying on the broken mattress, still holding the half-wet knight novel in his hand, snoring loudly, and showing no signs of waking up.
Levi shook his head, walked to the simple gas stove in the corner (thank God it was not soaked in water and could not be used), and heated up the oil.
The cheap beef shank sizzles in the pan, and the meaty aroma brought by the Maillard reaction quickly overpowers the musty smell of the basement. Levi only sprinkled a little bit of black pepper and fried it until it was halfway cooked before serving it out.
After leaving a portion for Don Quixote, Levi devoured his portion, feeling the heat and protein melting in his stomach and flowing to his limbs.
I don’t know if it’s because of the system improvement, but he can eat a lot more after coming to New York than before. The improvement in physical fitness may have also brought about an increase in appetite. He can now eat a full 500 steak and other ingredients in one meal.
Returning to his cubicle, Levi quickly immersed himself in reading and began to study hard.
His time is precious. Not only does he have to submit the data within 2 weeks, successfully transfer to get rewards and move out, but he also needs to pass the entrance test and rugby team selection one month later.
